messages:
dena: @channel Quick update: were opening a limited reservation window for the new A100X-80GB Dedicated pools in eu-south-1 (single AZ) and adding capacity to eu-central-1 (extra AZ). Reservations via Console go live at 14:30 UTC, API reservations available now (preview). Docs: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/a100x-eu-south

tom: Nice. Any per-customer caps for this window?

dena: Yes 1: temporary cap = 2 racks per customer in eu-south-1 and 4 racks in eu-central-1 while we balance inventory. Caps expire 2026-05-07 unless extended.

sam: Whats the recommended fallback if we run out during provisioning?

dena: Well automatically route overflow to compatible L40s or H100 instance pools; customers can opt into preferred fallback in their reservation. Expect 10-35% perf variance depending on model/context length. Reservation pricing applies to committed racks; overflow billed on-demand.

infra-bot: Allocation record created: dedicated:a100x:eu-south-1 (cap-17907). Deployment template "reserved-a100x-standard" published.

billing: Billing note: reservations made during preview are prorated to the provisioning date. Cross-AZ HA adds an extra monthly surcharge per rack. Full pricing table in billing doc.

support: Schedule: we'll host two migration office hours (EMEA & APAC) next week and offer free migration planning for customers reserving >=2 racks in these regions. Invite will be sent to flagged accounts.

dena: TL;DR: limited reservations for A100X-80GB in eu-south-1 + more capacity in eu-central-1, per-customer caps (2/4 racks), fallback to L40/H100, prorated billing, office hours + migration help. Ping @support for consults or reply here. :rocket:
